scientific_question: On the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 and Case 2 development conditions, is the cross-condition failure of the direct Low-64 field caused by near-nullspace content that can be removed by an exact reported-geometry A-transpose row-space lift, while keeping the same 12A+11A^T ledger as direct Low-64 PCGLS K11?

evidence_role.v220_2_boundary: The v220.2 observable K11/K16 fallback remains inconclusive and closed. v221 changes the initializer physics, not the residual threshold, validation tolerance of v220.2, or PCGLS stopping rule.

fixed_primary_initializer.name: low64_exact_rowspace_lift
fixed_primary_initializer.low64_field: The same rank-64 orthonormal physical basis and unregularized reported-geometry Moore-Penrose observation fit used by v218.1-v220.2.
fixed_primary_initializer.step_1: Compute p_low=A*x_low64 with the exact reported-geometry forward operator; charge 1A.
fixed_primary_initializer.step_2: Compute z=A^T*p_low with the exact reported-geometry adjoint; charge 1A^T. No preconditioner is applied inside the initializer, so z lies in the exact Euclidean range of A^T.
fixed_primary_initializer.step_3: Compute p_z=A*z with the exact reported-geometry forward operator; charge 1A.
fixed_primary_initializer.observable_scale: alpha=clip(real(<y,p_z>)/real(<p_z,p_z>),0,2); alpha=0 when the denominator is at most 1e-30. No truth, condition ID, rig ID, or frame label is available.
fixed_primary_initializer.refinement: unchanged strict geometry-Jacobi PCGLS v10.1 for exactly K10 iterations; the frozen Jacobi inverse diagonal appears only here, not in the exact row-space initializer
fixed_primary_initializer.reason_this_is_not_v220_threshold_retuni: v220 selects between two depths on the same direct Low-64 trajectory. v221 instead maps the Low-64 predicted measurement through exact A^T before refinement, then lets the fixed physical preconditioner act only inside one fixed PCGLS depth and uses no residual threshold.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must not import the v221 formal runner. It independently preprocesses both raw opened conditions, reconstructs each rig and Low-64 response, applies exact forward-adjoint-forward row-space lifting, observable scaling, separately coded geometry-Jacobi PCGLS recurrences, metrics, tails, controls, ledgers, and the two camera-permutation sentinels.
independent_validation.tolerance_rationale: The tolerances are frozen before any v221 field is generated. The 5e-8 field and dimensional-audit relative tolerance is 3.31 times the sealed v220.2 different-order maximum of 1.50948e-8 and remains seven orders of magnitude below the scientific field gate. Observable alpha and unclipped alpha retain the stricter 1e-10 absolute tolerance. These tolerances do not alter the invalid v220.2 adjudication.

stop_rules: Do not change the rank, basis, Moore-Penrose proxy, exact lift, Jacobi floor, alpha formula or clip, K10 depth, controls, metrics, gates, or validation tolerances after any v221 scientific field is generated.

If the primary fails either opened condition or the independent recomputation, close the exact row-space-lift explanation and do not rescue it by changing alpha bounds, adding directions, increasing depth, training a larger model, or renting a GPU.
A pass is post-open mechanism headroom only and does not authorize Case4/Case6, wall/RSS, external-generalization, curved-ray, or real-BOST claims.
